text.content:
Scene: @UUID[Compendium.points-of-interest.scenes.Scene.oIgh6u5KGdnDooXj]{06. The Larder}

Actors: @UUID[Compendium.points-of-interest.actors.Actor.FiEFewrlYzAAAUIF]{Grosh}, @UUID[Compendium.points-of-interest.actors.Actor.yMmKCxlS3tfoQoNF]{Murla}, @UUID[Compendium.points-of-interest.actors.Actor.MaFhW4hkMqtpTKCu]{Tuk}, @UUID[Compendium.points-of-interest.actors.Actor.TROjOnSMvg9JYgXL]{Hobb}, @UUID[Compendium.points-of-interest.actors.Actor.TYSmugwnxgYrf9qb]{Ederis Pallo}, @UUID[Compendium.points-of-interest.actors.Actor.DcvETdEAHymNfxt7]{Hesk Varro}, @UUID[Compendium.points-of-interest.actors.Actor.SHBByparJ2GCf14G]{Kael}

Zone Zone 16: Glenebon Uplands (wooded hollow below a granite shelf)
Hex 4.4 on the Stolen Lands map
Type Combat (massacre) + rescue and evidence
Threat Moderate 80 XP at party level 16
Creatures 4 hill giant butchers (level 14, Kingmaker Bestiary)

Irovetti's map note. A cleaver drawn beside the hollow, with "Moleg's men — tolerate" underneath and a tally of six marks crossed through.

Background. Kob Moleg sends four butchers to stock his larder from the uplands. Irovetti paid Moleg in coin and convicts to keep the giants off Pitax's western roads, and the tally counts the prisoner wagons he sent. The butchers run a smokehouse camp in the hollow. Three captives still live in the cages: a Pitaxian tax clerk, a Numerian scavenger and a Tiger Lord outrider. The clerk carries the last delivery receipt, sealed with Irovetti's signet.

Arrival.

Woodsmoke hangs low in the hollow, thick with the smell of salt and fat. Racks of split carcasses sway from a timber frame, and behind them a row of log cages leans against the cliff. Someone in the cages starts shouting, and four huge shapes rise from the fire with axes already in hand.

Features.

  • Smoking racks. Timber frames hung with carcasses. They grant standard cover and are difficult terrain. A Large creature can topple a rack with a DC 30 Athletics check; creatures in a 10-foot line beyond it take 6d6 bludgeoning damage (DC 35 basic Reflex).
  • Smokehouse. A sod-roofed hut full of choking smoke. Creatures inside are concealed; a creature that ends its turn inside must succeed at a DC 30 Fortitude save or become sickened 1.
  • Cages. Three log cages against the cliff. Each has Hardness 10, HP 40, and a lock (DC 30 Thievery). The butchers use the cages as hostages.
  • Fire pit. A creature shoved or knocked prone into the pit takes 4d6 fire damage.
  • Granite shelf. A 20-foot cliff above the hollow (DC 30 Athletics to Climb). The giants keep a rock pile on top.

Running the encounter. The butchers fight with confidence until two of them fall.

  1. Opening. The first butcher to act uses Menace Prey on the two PCs who look richest. The others close and use Twin Butchery on whoever leads. One butcher climbs the shelf path and uses Throw Rock from the rock pile.
  2. Hostage move. When a butcher drops below half HP, it moves to the cages and raises an axe over the clerk. It demands the PCs drop their weapons. A PC who gets to the cage first or makes a DC 32 Intimidation check stops the threat. Otherwise, on its next turn the butcher kills one captive (choose the outrider first; the clerk last).
  3. Rout. Hill giants are cowards. Once two butchers fall, each survivor tries to flee up the shelf path toward Kob Moleg's hold. A fleeing giant who reaches the ridge warns Moleg, and his forces expect the PCs.

Twist. The tax clerk, Ederis Pallo, recognises a PC who served at court or wore a kingdom tabard, and begs them to destroy the receipt. Ederis fears what Irovetti's loyalists or the PCs' own court would do to him for his role. The PCs decide whether to keep the receipt as evidence of Irovetti's deal with the giants.

Outcomes.

  • All giants slain. The PCs free the captives and take the receipt. Moleg loses a raiding team and learns nothing of the PCs' approach.
  • A giant escapes. Moleg's hold goes on alert; his next encounter starts with sentries ready.
  • Captives saved. The Numerian scavenger, Hesk Varro, offers to guide the PCs to the Lightwardens (#8) or the Annihilator (#9) as payment. The Tiger Lord outrider owes the PCs a life-debt.
  • Receipt kept. Proof of Irovetti's arrangement with Moleg. Presenting it in Pitax after liberation helps sway the city's nobility.

Rewards. 80 XP. Treasure: 1,200 gp in coin, silver plate and trade goods from the smokehouse; the giants' battle axe is a +2 greater striking battle axe sized for a Large creature (sell value or resize). The receipt grants a +2 circumstance bonus to one Kingdom check or Liberation activity tied to Pitaxian nobility.

Scaling. For a stronger party, add Kob Moleg's level 16 overseer (an elite hill giant butcher). At party level 18 the encounter drops to Low; use it as a breather.
